audit_headline: Spot On Lawn Care's primary category is set to the generic 'Services' instead of a lawn-care-specific category, which significantly weakens its relevance signal when Lakeland residents search for lawn care or landscaping.
summary: Spot On Lawn Care has a perfect 5.0 rating from 15 reviews and 10 or more photos, but faces two critical visibility issues: its primary category is the vague 'Services' rather than a trade-specific category like 'Lawn care service' or 'Landscaper,' and its most recent review is from 5 years ago. The profile links to a Facebook page instead of a dedicated website, and that page could not be read during this audit.

sections.title: Google Business Profile
sections.summary: The profile has hours, a phone number, and 10 or more photos, but its primary category is set to the generic 'Services' rather than a lawn-care-specific category, which is a major relevance problem.

findings.observation: The primary category is 'Services,' a generic placeholder that does not signal lawn care, landscaping, or any specific trade to Google's algorithm.
findings.recommendation: Change the primary category to 'Lawn care service' or 'Landscaper' to match what customers search for and what the business actually does.

findings.observation: The profile lists hours (7:00 AM – 7:00 PM, seven days a week) and includes a phone number ((352) 232-8259), both of which are present and complete.
The profile has 10 or more photos, which meets the floor for visual content, though more recent work photos can continue to strengthen the profile.
The profile is not marked as a service-area business, which is appropriate if Spot On Lawn Care operates from this address and serves customers at their locations.

sections.title: Reviews
sections.summary: Spot On Lawn Care has a perfect 5.0 rating from 15 reviews, but all five visible recent reviews are from 5 years ago, which signals to both Google and potential customers that the business may be inactive or not prioritizing current feedback.

findings.observation: The most recent review visible in the profile is from 5 years ago, and all five recent reviews available are from that same period, indicating no fresh review activity in years.
findings.recommendation: Start asking current customers for reviews after each completed job to rebuild review velocity and show the business is active.

findings.observation: The 15 reviews yield a 5.0 rating, and the five visible reviews consistently mention timely service, professionalism, reasonable pricing, and quality results—three specifically call out reliability and communication.
The Google Places API does not reveal whether the owner has responded to reviews, so this audit cannot confirm response activity.
findings.recommendation: Log in to the Google Business Profile and verify that you have responded to all reviews, especially the positive ones, to demonstrate engagement and build trust with prospective customers.

sections.title: Website
sections.summary: The profile links to a Facebook page (facebook.com/spotonlawncare863) instead of a dedicated website, and that page returned an error (HTTP 400) when this audit attempted to read it.

findings.observation: The 'website' field on the profile points to a Facebook page rather than a standalone business website, and that page could not be read during this audit (HTTP 400 error).
findings.recommendation: Verify that the Facebook page is publicly accessible and displays your services, contact information, and work examples. Consider building a simple dedicated website with your business name, 'lawn care,' and 'Lakeland, FL' in the homepage title, a click-to-call phone link, and LocalBusiness structured data to strengthen local search signals.

findings.observation: Because the linked page could not be read, this audit cannot confirm whether it includes click-to-call links, mobile optimization, or local business markup.
findings.recommendation: Check the Facebook page on a mobile device to ensure visitors can easily tap to call (352) 232-8259 and see your services and location.

sections.title: Missed Calls
sections.summary: The profile lists a phone number and seven-day hours from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, which covers most customer inquiry windows, though calls outside those hours will go unanswered.

findings.observation: The profile displays the phone number (352) 232-8259 and hours that run 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM every day, leaving a 12-hour window each night when calls will not be answered.
findings.recommendation: Set up a missed-call text-back service or voicemail that confirms you'll return calls the next morning, and periodically call your own number after hours to verify the voicemail message is clear and professional.

fix_list.action: Change the primary category from 'Services' to 'Lawn care service' or 'Landscaper.'
fix_list.rationale: The current 'Services' category is generic and does not signal lawn care to Google's algorithm, which significantly weakens relevance when Lakeland residents search for lawn care or landscaping. A trade-specific category is a core local-search best practice.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Edit profile -> Business category (select primary category)

fix_list.action: Ask your next 5–10 completed customers for a Google review.
fix_list.rationale: All visible recent reviews are from 5 years ago, which signals inactivity to both Google and potential customers. Fresh reviews are a recognized trust and recency signal.
fix_list.where: After each job, send a text or email with a direct link to your Google review page (find the short link in your Google Business Profile dashboard under 'Get more reviews')

fix_list.action: Verify that your Facebook page (facebook.com/spotonlawncare863) is publicly accessible and displays services, contact info, and work photos.
fix_list.rationale: The profile links to this Facebook page as the website, but it returned an error (HTTP 400) during this audit. If the page is inaccessible or incomplete, visitors from your Google profile will bounce.
fix_list.where: Facebook -> Your Page -> Settings & Privacy -> Settings -> Privacy -> Page visibility (ensure 'Page published' is on); then review the About section and recent posts

fix_list.action: Log in to your Google Business Profile and confirm you have responded to all 15 reviews.
fix_list.rationale: The API does not reveal owner responses, so this audit cannot confirm whether you've replied. Responding to reviews—especially positive ones—demonstrates engagement and builds trust with prospective customers.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile dashboard -> Reviews -> Reply to each review

fix_list.action: Add 5–10 recent photos of completed lawn work to your Google Business Profile.
fix_list.rationale: The profile has 10 or more photos, but fresh images of current work reinforce that the business is active and showcase quality to prospective customers.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Add photos -> Upload recent job photos

fix_list.action: Build a simple one-page website with 'Spot On Lawn Care,' 'lawn care,' and 'Lakeland, FL' in the homepage <title>, a click-to-call link for (352) 232-8259, and LocalBusiness structured data.
fix_list.rationale: A Facebook page as the sole web presence is a weaker relevance signal than a dedicated site with local keywords and structured data. A basic site strengthens local search signals and gives you a property you control.
fix_list.where: Use a simple website builder (Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress) or hire a local web developer; then update the website field in your Google Business Profile to the new URL

fix_list.action: Set up a missed-call text-back service or update your voicemail to confirm you'll return calls the next morning.
fix_list.rationale: Your hours leave a 12-hour nightly gap (7:00 PM – 7:00 AM) when calls go unanswered. A clear voicemail or automated text reassures callers and reduces the chance they'll move on to a competitor.
fix_list.where: Contact your mobile carrier about text-back services, or record a new voicemail message on your phone

not_checked: Whether you have responded to your 15 Google reviews — the API does not expose owner responses. Log in to your Google Business Profile and check the Reviews section.

Whether your Facebook page is publicly visible and displays your services — it returned an error during this audit. Visit facebook.com/spotonlawncare863 in a private browser window to confirm it loads.
Whether the Facebook page includes a click-to-call button or displays your phone number prominently — the page could not be read. Check it on a mobile device.
Your actual answer rate for incoming calls — this audit has no call data. Call your own number after 7:00 PM to hear your voicemail and verify it's clear and professional.
closing_note: Spot On Lawn Care has a strong foundation—a perfect rating and loyal past customers—but the generic 'Services' category and five-year review gap are holding back visibility. Fixing the category and restarting review momentum are quick, high-impact moves that align with recognized local-search best practices.
